maddeler.e: حَضْرَمِيّ • (ḥaḍramiyy) (feminine حَضْرَمِيَّة (ḥaḍramiyya), masculine plural حَضَارِم (ḥaḍārim), feminine plural حَضْرَمِيَّات (ḥaḍramiyyāt))
maddeler.t:
Etymology tree
Arabic حَضْرَمَوْت (ḥaḍramawt)
Proto-Afroasiatic
Proto-Semitic
Arabic ـِيّ (-iyy)
Arabic حضرمي
From حَضْرَمَوْت (ḥaḍramawt) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
g: Hadhrami (relating to Hadhramawt or its people)
